_metadata.source: Cross-source derived parameters and judgment-based estimates
_metadata.note: Geographic and profile multipliers are judgment-based ranges informed by DBIR/IRIS patterns. Dampening parameters are explicitly judgment-based pending empirical replacement.

_substrata_assessment.note: Cross-source derived parameters and judgment-based estimates. Not a primary source.

dampening_config._citation: VERIS VCDB co-occurrence analysis (10,037 incidents, scripts/compute_dampening.py) for vector_k; judgment-based for factor_k (VERIS lacks population denominators needed for within-vector derivation)
dampening_config.factor_k_source: Judgment-based (0.70). VERIS incident data cannot derive within-vector dampening: sector×size co-occurrence in incidents conflates risk interaction with population correlation (financial orgs tend to be large). Requires population denominators unavailable in VCDB.
dampening_config.vector_k_source: VERIS VCDB empirical (10,037 incidents, 1,789 with mapped vectors, 218 multi-vector). Bimodal pairwise structure: exploitation↔credential/phishing are substitutes (lift~0.2, vectors rarely co-occur), credential↔phishing are strong complements (lift=8.29, 95% CI [7.46,9.18]). Median pairwise lift=1.33 → k=0.75, but no single k fits the bimodal distribution. k=0.85 is a defensible aggregate: dampens the dominant credential-phishing co-occurrence without over-dampening independent exploitation pairs.
dampening_config.max_composite_source: Transparent cap: no profile should produce >5x the base rate. Rationale: IRIS overall upper bound (10%) / base rate mode (1%) ~ 10x; 5x allows differentiation while preventing runaway stacking.

veris_pairwise_lifts._note: Empirical lift values from VERIS VCDB. Lift>1 = vectors co-occur (complements); lift<1 = vectors are alternatives (substitutes). See data/veris/dampening_analysis.json for full output.

credibility_k._citation: Bühlmann structural parameter k = σ²(process) / σ²(hypothetical means). Lower k = faster credibility growth. Derived from peer grid variance (σ² hypothetical means) and assumed process variance based on vector observability characteristics.
credibility_k._methodology: σ²(hypothetical means) estimated from peer grid TEF variance within revenue bands. Process variance assumed proportional to observation noise: exploitation (well-observed via WAF/IDS) < credential/phishing (moderate, auth logs/gateway) << supply chain (sparse, mostly invisible).

data_vintage.veris_vcdb: VERIS Community Database (10,037 validated incidents, multi-year). Used for cross-vector dampening coefficient empirical derivation.
